title: Form W-9, Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification
description: Gives a business or client your taxpayer identification number so they can report what they pay you.

title: Form W-4, Employee's Withholding Certificate
description: Tells a new or current employer how much federal income tax to withhold from your pay.

title: Form W-4P, Withholding Certificate for Periodic Pension or Annuity Payments
description: Sets the federal income tax withheld from pension or annuity payments.

title: Form SS-4, Application for Employer Identification Number
description: Applies for an EIN for a new business, trust, estate or other entity.

title: Form 4506-T, Request for Transcript of Tax Return
description: Asks the IRS to send your tax return transcripts, often for a mortgage or loan.

title: Form 8822, Change of Address
description: Tells the IRS your home mailing address changed so notices reach you.

title: Form 2848, Power of Attorney and Declaration of Representative
description: Lets an accountant or other representative talk to the IRS and act for you on your taxes.

title: Form 8821, Tax Information Authorization
description: Lets a person or business see your IRS records without acting for you.

title: Form 14039, Identity Theft Affidavit
description: Reports that someone used your identity to file taxes or commit other tax fraud.

title: Form 1040-ES, Estimated Tax for Individuals
description: Figures and pays quarterly estimated tax when income has no withholding.

title: Form 941, Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return
description: Reports wages paid and payroll taxes withheld each quarter by an employer.

title: Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File
description: Asks for six more months to file your individual federal tax return.

title: Form W-7, Application for IRS Individual Taxpayer Identification Number
description: Applies for an ITIN when a person must file taxes but cannot get a Social Security number.

title: Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification
description: Proves a new employee is allowed to work in the United States.

title: VA Form 21-4138, Statement in Support of Claim
description: A veteran's own written statement that supports a disability or benefits claim.

title: VA Form 21-526EZ, Application for Disability Compensation
description: Applies for VA disability compensation and related benefits for service-connected conditions.

title: VA Form 21-0781, Statement in Support of Claim for PTSD
description: Describes the events behind a veteran's post-traumatic stress disorder claim.

title: Form DS-11, Application for a U.S. Passport
description: Applies in person for a first passport, or for a child or a replacement passport.

title: Form CMS-40B, Application for Enrollment in Medicare Part B
description: Signs up for Medicare Part B medical insurance outside the automatic-enrollment path.

title: Form CMS-L564, Request for Employment Information
description: Asks an employer to confirm group health coverage so Medicare enrollment avoids a penalty.

title: Form CMS-1696, Appointment of Representative
description: Names someone who may act for a Medicare beneficiary on claims and appeals.
